summary: Greenland Mines Ltd filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 1,765,426 common shares at $12.00 and pre-funded warrants for 1,434,580 shares at $11.999, totaling roughly $38.4 million before expenses. The purchase price equals the share price less a $0.001 exercise price; warrants are immediately exercisable with a 9.99% beneficial ownership cap. No placement agent was retained; pricing was negotiated directly. The offering terminates September 25, 2026, with settlement expected September 24, 2026, against a $14.15 prior close.
